gloss: wheeled bag; rolling carry-on; carrier bag

definitions.explanation: A bag or case with wheels and an extendable handle, pulled along rather than carried. From English 'carry bag'. Also used for a soft carrier for pets.

examples.japanese: キャリーバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walk pulling a wheeled bag.

examples.japanese: ⟦{機内|きない}{持|も}ち{込|こ}み→機内持ち込み：10204_kinaimochikomi⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧キャリーバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a carry-on wheeled bag for taking into the cabin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{階段|かいだん}→階段：00782_kaidan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧キャリーバッグ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}ち{上|あ}げなければ→持ち上げる：02313_mochiageru⟧⟦なら→なる：01970_naru⟧ず、⟦{重|おも}くて→重い：00804_omoi⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だった。
examples.english: On the stairs I had to lift the wheeled bag, and it was heavy and tough.

notes:
A bag with wheels and a pull-out handle. Used for travel luggage and also for soft pet carriers with wheels.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スーツケース→スーツケース：01781_suutsukeesu⟧: suitcase — a hard-shell traveling case; many also have wheels, and the words overlap
- キャリー⟦ケース→ケース：03841_keesu⟧: carry case — near-synonym, often used for the hard-shell wheeled type
- ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧カバン: travel bag — general term for any bag used when traveling
